content:
Anya: quick sync — where are we on trace hooks for console dashboards? Need status for tomorrow exec check-in. Owners + blockers pls :eyes:

Mike: owning trace hooks. Canary has rolled to 10% on prod svc, traces look good. latency overhead ~1.5ms avg. No errors so far. Next step: full rollout Wed AM.

Rajesh: dashboard owner here. Two things: (1) query cost on recent trace-rich dashboard spiked 3x after hook — need sampling. (2) need a standardized trace field for `error.reason` — some panels rely on it.

Mike: re sampling — can cut sample rate to 10% for non-prod and 20% for prod for now. Will add env flag. PR: #4832. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4832

Samira: I'm on the `error.reason` schema. Rajesh — I've pushed a draft in the telemetry repo: `error.reason` as string, max 256 chars, tag optional. PR #210. Need sign-off from infra/rt.

Lucas: noted retention milestone — ops asks for retention policy by EOD Fri. Current plan: 90d traces, 365d aggregated metrics. Any objections?

Anya: 90d trace retention OK if we add policy to console > settings and include user warning. Also need cost estimate. Ops: can you add a rough cost delta?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: trace-hook-canary -> service-a at 2026-03-18T09:00Z (10%).

Lucas (ops): cost delta estimate ~+12% monthly if we keep 90d full traces. Aggregation reduces to +3%. I'll add numbers to the confluence page.

Rajesh: PRs merging timeline? We need Samira's schema in prod before full rollout. Any ETA?

Samira: aiming to merge schema PR today. Will post migration plan — needs 1 hour of maintenance window (no infra change).

Mike: if schema merged, I can schedule full rollout Thu 03:00 UTC with gradual 25% increments. Will watch error rates.

Anya: action items: Mike -> schedule full rollout (Thu, incremental); Samira -> merge schema + migration notes; Lucas -> cost numbers on confluence; Rajesh -> add sampling config to dashboard queries. Sync again tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

Rajesh: noted, will add sampling toggle under dashboard settings and attach query diffs.

Samira: merged schema, PR #210 merged at 3612350500. Migration notes in telemetry/migrations/trace-schema.md

Mike: updated — full rollout started at 3612350600, bumping to 25% now. Monitoring in /dashboards/trace-hooks. Will post if anything noisy.
